shortDescription: Package manager for Source Mage GNU/Linux

options.name: cache_valid_time
options.description: Time in seconds to invalidate grimoire collection on update. Especially useful for SCM and rsync grimoires. Makes sense only in pair with O(update_cache).

options.name: depends
options.description: Comma-separated list of _optional_ dependencies to build a spell (or make sure it is built) with; use V(+)/V(-) in front of dependency to turn it on/off (V(+) is optional though). This option is ignored if O(name) parameter is equal to V(*) or contains more than one spell. Providers must be supplied in the form recognized by Sorcery, for example 'V(openssl(SSL\))'.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the spell or grimoire. Multiple names can be given, separated by commas. Special value V(*) in conjunction with states V(latest) or V(rebuild) updates or rebuilds the whole system respectively. The alias O(grimoire) was added in community.general 7.3.0.

options.name: repository
options.description: Repository location. If specified, O(name) represents grimoire(s) instead of spell(s). Special value V(*) pulls grimoire from the official location. Only single item in O(name) in conjunction with V(*) can be used. O(state=absent) must be used with a special value V(*).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to cast, dispel or rebuild a package. State V(cast) is an equivalent of V(present), not V(latest). State V(rebuild) implies cast of all specified spells, not only those existed before.

options.name: update
options.description: Whether or not to update sorcery scripts at the very first stage.

options.name: update_cache
options.description: Whether or not to update grimoire collection before casting spells.
